sections.Profile:
The Houdini pinball machine, released by American Pinball in 2017, is a captivating tribute to the legendary magician. Designed by Joe Balcer, it features intricate mechanics and engaging software by Josh Kugler. The playfield includes unique elements such as three magnets that control the ball's movement, a 20-inch launch into a steamer trunk, and an interactive theater marquee.
